summary: Session 2 of 2 (final) for set 006 — the Configurator handoff record. Documentation only, no engine code change. Created configurator-handoff.md enumerating the exact new engine contract from Session 1 (cnb:keysig-style, cnb:keysig-bar-color/-thickness/-extent-semis, cnb:keysig-tonic-octave) with type/default/units/semantics and cnb/config.ly + cnb/keysig.ly file/line references, and mapped each to the Configurator's keys.keySignature fields. Resolved the two mappings S1 deferred to this handoff: (1) the separator thicknessPct unit conversion — thickness = thicknessPct / (10 * semitones-per-staff-space), anchored exactly at 160/40 = 4 on the default staff; and (2) an octave-numbering mismatch on tonicOctave — the Configurator puts middle C at octave 1 (absoluteSemi = pc + oct*12, grid semitone 12 = middle C) while the engine uses the raw ly:make-pitch octave where middle C = octave 0, so the exporter must emit cnb:keysig-tonic-octave = placement.tonicOctave - 1 (verified vs test-unit.ly). Also flagged separator.enabled:false as having no direct engine bar-only toggle (thickness-0 workaround noted), and gutter.paddingH / dot.radiusPct / non-scale-from-tonic placement.rule as preview-only. color is a direct hex passthrough; extentSemis is 1:1. Marked backlog items 2.1/2.2/2.4 resolved (new §5 subsection + §2 header note; 2.3 stays cancelled). Per the cross-repo rule this set does NOT bump docs/CNB-LY-EXPORT-SPEC-v1_2.md. Verification (lightweight, out-of-band-or-none, no metered calls): full suites re-run green — unit 287/287, integration 250/250 (353 assertions, 11 specs); every pre-existing golden SVG/harvest is byte-identical, so the baseline is byte-stable with default settings. Deliverable commit bad0cd8. Set 006 is ready to close.
